newsitem.title: USA: Northern States seeks hold on application.
newsitem.headline: Northern States seeks hold on application.

text.p: Northern States Power Co said Wednesday it asked the Nuclear Regulatory Commission to suspend review of the company's application for a license to build and operate an alternative spent nuclear fuel storage facility.
The facility would be in Florence Township in Goodhue County, north of Lake City, Minn.

The utility asked that the application be put on hold while the Minnesota Court of Appeals reviews a lawsuit by the Prairie Island Indian Community against the Minnesota Environmental Quality Board (MEQB).

The Prairie Island Community has challenged MEQB's October 2 decision to end the search for an alternative storage site in Goodhue County and grant Northern States Power permission to store additional spent fuel at its Prairie Island nuclear generating plant.

Ed Watzl, Northern State's vice president of nuclear generation, said the utility already has spent about $3 million on the alternative siting process and could spend another $1 million by 1997 if the process continues.
